label: Not every world of the route validates VARYING_DOMAINS_RIGID_IDENTITY_AND_NECESSITY_4 transfer
paraphrase: Not every world/predicate instance of the supplied Ontic profile satisfies the forward transfer from a box of existence-guarded universal quantification to an existence-guarded universal quantification of a box; at least one instance fails (classically; the Lean type is the bare negation of the universally quantified policy). It does not say that the transfer fails at every world or for every predicate.
